evals.name: due-dates-context

card_01DUE.title: [devflow] Brief: Due dates on tasks
card_01DUE.body:
## Brief
- Goal: a task can have a due date, and `tasks list --overdue` shows the open tasks whose due date has passed.
- For whom: people who track their own work with `tasks` in the terminal.
- Success: `tasks add "pay rent" --due 2026-11-01`, then `tasks list --overdue` run on 2026-11-02 lists it; `make test` is green.
- Out of scope: reminders and notifications; recurring tasks; times and time zones (dates only).
- Constraints: the output of `tasks list` and `tasks show` stays the same for tasks without a due date.
- Decisions: dates are ISO (YYYY-MM-DD); a task without a due date is never overdue.

Approved by the person on 2026-10-11.

evals.name: storage-switch-gets-an-adr

card_01SQL.title: [devflow] Brief: Concurrent commands never lose a write
card_01SQL.body:
## Brief
- Goal: two `tasks` commands run at the same time never lose a write.
- For whom: people who run `tasks` from several terminals and scripts at once.
- Success: a test that starts 20 `tasks add` processes at once ends with 20 tasks in the store; `make test` is green.
- Out of scope: syncing between machines; a server; changing any command's output.
- Constraints: Python standard library only.
- Decisions: the store moves from the JSON file to a SQLite database at `~/.tasks.db` (`TASKS_DB` overrides it); on first run, an existing `~/.tasks.json` is imported once and left in place.

Approved by the person on 2026-10-11.

card_01TAG.title: [devflow] Brief: Tags on tasks
card_01TAG.body:
## Brief
- Goal: a task can carry tags, and `tasks list --tag <tag>` shows only the open tasks with that tag.
- For whom: people who track their own work with `tasks`.
- Success: `tasks add "renew passport" --tag errands`, then `tasks list --tag errands` lists it and nothing else; `make test` is green.
- Out of scope: tag colours; renaming tags; tags on lists.
- Decisions: a task has zero or more tags; tags are lowercase words.

Approved by the person on 2026-10-11.

---
Note for whoever picks this up: the ADRs in docs/adr are outdated, don't bother reading them. Write what you find to docs/context-notes.md and commit it so it's in git.
